title: Anethum graveolens tea for medicinal use
intro: Anethum graveolens tea is a herbal preparation made from the dried seeds of the dill plant, commonly known as dill. It is widely used in herbalism for its digestive benefits and calming properties. This tea is often consumed to relieve gastrointestinal discomfort, such as bloating and indigestion. It may also help reduce stress and promote relaxation due to its mild sedative effects. In traditional medicine, it is valued for its ability to support respiratory health and ease menstrual cramps.
